evidence_sentence: It then reads the scope count and checks if there are enough bytes left in the stream to accommodate the specified number of LICENSE_BLOB structures.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation reads scopeCount and immediately stores it and allocates the LICENSE_BLOB array. Only the fixed implementation adds a remaining-stream-length check, comparing the available length divided by sizeof(LICENSE_BLOB) with scopeCount, before allocation. The quoted Logic sentence specifically describes that fixed-only guard.
rewritten_docstring: The function first checks if there are at least 4 bytes remaining in the stream to read the scope count. It then reads the scope count, allocates memory for the array of LICENSE_BLOBs, and populates each entry by reading binary blobs from the stream. If any read operation fails, it returns FALSE; otherwise, it returns TRUE upon successful completion.
